title.zh-TW: 捲動時圖片從一條縫打開
title.en: Images open from a slit on scroll

summary.zh-TW: 捲到圖片時（三張同寬），圖片用 clip-path 從一條縫慢慢打開：第一張從中間往上下撐開、第二張從左邊擦開、第三張從底部升起，裡面的圖示同時從放大縮回原尺寸。往回捲會再關上。
summary.en: As each image scrolls in, clip-path opens it from a slit — the first splits from the centre, the second wipes from the left, the third rises from the bottom — while the icon inside zooms back to normal. Scrolling back closes them again.

text.zh-TW: inset 的四個數字是「上、右、下、左各裁掉多少」。上下各裁 50% 只剩中間一條線，補間到全部 0% 就是整張打開。
text.en: inset’s four numbers are how much to cut from the top, right, bottom and left. Cutting 50% top and bottom leaves a line; tweening to all 0% opens it fully.

text.zh-TW: 右邊裁 100%＝完全看不到，補間到 0 時會從左邊往右擦開。換一個邊就能換方向，不用改程式。
text.en: Cutting 100% on the right hides everything; tweening to 0 wipes in from the left. Change which side to change the direction — no code changes.

text.zh-TW: 打開的同時，裡面的圖從放大縮回原尺寸，像鏡頭往後拉，比單純打開更有深度。外框負責裁切、裡面負責縮放，兩層分開做。
text.en: While it opens, the picture inside zooms back from larger, like a camera pulling out — more depth than a plain reveal. The frame clips and the inner layer scales.

text.zh-TW: 圖片頂端從畫面 85% 的位置開始打開、到 35% 時完全打開，也就是捲到畫面中間時剛好看完整張。
text.en: It starts opening when the image top reaches 85% of the screen and is fully open at 35% — completely visible by the middle of the screen.
